column1: # Title:    FY 2019 Preliminary Data Table 4 -- Average Monthly Percentages of Children Served in Regulated Settings vs. Settings Legally Operating Without Regulation
# Agency:   HHS Administration for Children and Families (ACF), Office of Child Care
# Program:  Child Care and Development Fund (CCDF)
# Origin:   ACF-801 case-level administrative records, FY2019
# Retrieved: 2026-09-03. acf.gov filters on User-Agent -- a browser UA returns 200,
#            a default client UA returns 403. Not a hard block.
# Used for: Regulated vs unregulated split. Coarser view of Table 6.
#           NOT a build input. Floor/diagnostic only -- covers subsidised
#           children only, and family copay is unobserved so the model paid/
#           unpaid line cannot be drawn from these cells.
# Caveats:  "adjusted" = raw state count x ACF-800 pooling factor. "0%" often
#           means <0.5%. Multi-setting children counted proportionally by hours.
#           "-" = not reported; American Samoa and Virgin Islands filed nothing.
#           Months submitted: Alabama 9, Georgia 2, Louisiana 11; others 12.
#           Georgia Invalid share is high after an eligibility-system transition.
